title: PV-battery home under a Pakistani time-of-use tariff: converter model and energy management (code and data)
description: Simulink plant scripts, Python energy-management code, input data and all result files for the article 'Rule-based versus optimal energy management of a photovoltaic-battery home under a Pakistani time-of-use tariff: from converter dynamics to household cost'. Code: MIT. Data and results produced in this work: CC BY 4.0. Third-party inputs (PVGIS-ERA5, NASA POWER) remain under their providers' terms.
